claim_falsified: The scalar-interest tilt-dual bracket is always exact: min_beta max_z between(S_psi-beta S_lambda; z) equals the exact global profiled-Ds value. FALSE: two explicit tilt quadratics give a rational lower certificate strictly above the exhaustive global optimum.
comparison_domain: All six label-permutation-canonical nonempty K=3 row assignments; every nuisance block is nonsingular, so DS9 in-bin and DS11 pseudo-inverse domains coincide.
duplication_scope: Splitting every weight among identical duplicate rows preserves the witness under ScoreQuant's duplicate-collapsed atom semantics.
No preservation claim is made for an unmerged row-assignment domain, which can split identical rows across cells.

exact_quantities.certificate_inequality: max_z q_z(beta) >= (14/25) q_first(beta) + (11/25) q_optimum(beta) for every real beta
exact_quantities.support_minimality: For K=3, N=3 has only the singleton partition up to relabeling, so its tilt dual closes exactly; N=4 is minimal.

order_one_family.construction: For integer r>=2, give each displayed atom weight (1-1/r)/4 and add r distinct bounded rational atoms, row j having score (j/(r+1)^2,j/(r+1)^3) and weight 1/r^2. The added mass is exactly 1/r.
order_one_family.proof: On every compact beta set, an added-only cell contributes O(1/r) by cellwise Cauchy-Schwarz, while a cell containing a base atom has mass bounded below and its quadratic changes by O(1/r). The displayed coercive mixed quadratic keeps all dual minimizers in one common compact interval. The same cellwise bounds in the scalar generalized Schur formula give d_r->d and g_r^+->g^+, so the gap remains bounded below by a positive constant.

verification.method: exact rational exhaustive enumeration plus convex-mixture lower certificate
verification.notes: All arithmetic is fractions.Fraction. The certificate does not need the generally algebraic exact minimizer of the full quadratic envelope.
